Selecting products with industry leading performance, longevity, ethical practices and sustainability results in the maximum benefit to our clients.Adapt Energy is a distinguished and award-winning leader in the field of residential & commercial solar, battery, and EV charging solutions. With an unwavering commitment to sustainability, innovation, and customer satisfaction, we offer a comprehensive range of services to meet the diverse energy needs of businesses, organisations, and communities.Core Competencies:Comprehensive Renewable Solutions:We specialise in delivering integrated solar, battery storage, and electric vehicle charging solutions that reduce carbon footprints and promote energy independence. From small-scale installations to multi-megawatt projects, our installers expertise spans the entire spectrum of solar, battery, EV charging and energy management solutions.Turnkey Project Management:Our end-to-end capabilities ensure seamless project execution. So happy we chose Adapt Energy for our solar and battery! The install was stress-free, the team was awesome, and it feels great knowing we’re cutting bills and using our own power.

Adapt Energy were very professional and communicative and spent a good amount of time going through our requirements and answering any questions we had to ensure we ordered the correct system to suit our household. The installers they used, Cooper Solar and Electrical, were excellent. They turned up on time. Sales was brilliant as the quote could be updated in real time as we changed the configuration of the system. Our installers from Coronis Solar were on time, informative as they went through each stage as the commenced and finished then explained what was being done next. Fantastic customer service, thanks to Katie by resolving the issue on the battery installation. It’s a quite a drama but it’s a good thing is Adapt look after there customers. Thank you Adapt Solar

Inny, Liam and the team at Adapt Energy were absolutely fantastic to deal with throughout the entire process. From exceptional knowledge and guidance through the consultation, design and grid connection process through to strong relationships with installers of high quality, who were friendly and prompt, cannot speak highly enough of Adapt Energy for all solar and battery needs

Steve and Paul from Adapt Energy were great to work with. They provided a competitive quote using top rated panels and batteries designed to suit my needs. They helped to simply explain aspects I didn’t understand which made the process easy. Highly recommend.

First contact was with Joshua. He came out to the house to discuss the whole project. My experience with Josh was remarkable and essentially the reason I decided to proceed with Adapt Energy. He didn't once apply any sales pressure and remained available for the most important thing I needed - information. He told me he would provide the best price possible and based on other quotes I received, he did exactly that. I had another 2 quotes from other companies and 1 of the other quotes came in with a bigger and more efficient system.  It was hard to decide as the other company was fantastic as well. Adept Energy was 1 of 4 installer quotes I got - 2 from Solar Quotes, 1 from a personal recommendation and 1 well-rated local installer. To be fair all 4 were good, but the 2 from Solar Quotes took the time to talk me through the options. and didn't just grab for the money. My wife and I are in a large detached house and have had solar since NSW Labor ran the last solar scheme. They both told us - get a decent size system with no battery - which we were committed to getting. A good FIT and sensible management should see us OK. Adept got the job as the very personable sales rep also advised getting a battery when we want to go EV - which is our goal - and an inverter that could later be unlocked to allow a charger to be connected.They promised to install within 4 weeks and were as good as their word. The installation was done in a day and the workmen were neat/ tidy and pretty efficient, bracing, wiring and distance of panels from gutter as per Solar Quotes - with only one snag. A dongle or cable was missing which meant we couldn't see the system data on the app.Post the installation - the wheels began to come off. I regret not withholding payment until the system was 100%.While the front-end of Adept's business is very good - the back end was not so strong. A good week later I had not heard anything about the missing piece and received no warranty or paperwork. I arced up but their operations team were hard to reach, slow to respond. It took a complaint to Solar Quotes to get things moving.If you buy a $25 clock at Bunnings you get a warrantee in the box and instructions on how to use it and what it does - with Adept you get nothing for $9K. The installer gave me the password and access to the SEMS app he had set up to test our system, which was just as well as Adept gave us nothing. When I asked if they could tell me how the app worked and what it all meant - they said they couldn't help. If this is your first foray - good luck! How long wouldit take them to put together a welcome pack using links to Solar Quotes articles on how to best utilise/ maximise your solar system and to add a link to the SEMS app instructions - which I found on-line?No sooner had they finally got our metering system on-line  - so we could see what we're doing on the SEMS app -for which we received no link or any kind of information on how to read/ operate it - than our air conditioner went on the blink. Couldn’t understand it - normally very reliable. I checked the fusebox and discovered that the air con had been incorrectly wired to the solar hot water switch which is normally off in summer. The Adept electrician told me that the solar hot water was still on its own circuit, which it was on the previous system. Now we couldn't have air con without putting on the water! That's not to say that the solar hot water was even on that circuit and begged the question what was our solar hot water wired to and if it’s the house then have we been paying for water to be heated needlessly for the past 3 weeks? I advised Adept's operations to sort this ASAP as I was  seriously concerned about your competency on all levels. They did respond within a day and it turned out it was not wired incorrectly, but the wiring block had slipped down behind the fusebox giving the appearance of it being wired incorrectly.In a final twist I got an email from my energy supplier saying that a request for a new meter had been received = presumably from the electrician. This would be completed in 16 working days. I assumed that some kind of upgrade was needed, but when heard nothing more I followed up with the retailer to be told we already had one and no upgrade was needed. Finally, exactly a month after the installation it was all done and I could move to a new retailer with a much higher FIT, which would see us break even or better over the hotter months.To be clear - I'm not saying Adept Energy are shonky - the system I've got is working very well - so far - but they seem to lack an awareness about customer care and don't seem to have a big enough team to handle issues as they arise. They don't seem to understand the value of going with the customer on their solar journey which can last 2- 3 phases.The old sales mantra used to be don't sell the customer one car - sell him five over his lifetime, which has got lost in this insane neoliberal age of maximum profit/ minimum investment. In their Solar Quotes profile Adept mention "....an unwavering commitment to customer service," but this was curiously absent in my case. As my old school reports used to unfailingly say, "Must do better..."

After registering my interest with solarquotes, I was contacted by all 3 very quickly. I reviewed the systems offered and there wasnt anything that was a deal breaker for me. In fact I was rather impressed by all the quotes and the speed and communication they displayed. My decision in the end came down to the contractual obligations. One contract had a clause they could increase the price after the acceptance of the quote, but the buyer could terminate the agreement if they disagreed. Personally I felt this was disappointing because after going through the whole process then having to cancel the contract and then get someone else on board was unacceptable to me. Ray at Adapt Energy sealed the deal, he was extremely understanding of how I hate contracts and fine print like this, and dont trust companies that have a need to have so many clauses in what is a simple transaction. I pay the money, they install the product, so it should be that simple. I also texted Ray on a holiday, very early in the morning, and I took my finger off the phone and it rang so quick I could not believe it. He also agreed to vary the terms of the installation, and instead of up to 90 days to install that most of them have, we had a verbal agreement of 9 days. I did not feel any need to reword the contract, I took him at his word, and he delivered every detail of the installation, followed up after hrs and on weekends in his own family time. I love this guy. I also added some tigo optimisers for shading, after our agreement, but I didnt allow enough time for the arrival for the installers. When they arrived after the install, Ray organised them to come back 2 days later and they fitted them. I also want to mention their contractors were exceptional, polite, experienced, tidy, and genuinely were such good guys, Glenn and Damian. Fantastic.If trust of word is highly rated by you, in this crappy world where everyone is trying to cheat someone, then Ray is who you call.
